seg.seg_note: Pre-Fortive-spin structure: five segments (Test & Measurement, Environmental, Life Sciences & Diagnostics, Dental, Industrial Technologies) + Other (unallocated corporate). Release has no segment table; segment sales / OP / depreciation / amortization and segment sales-growth components from 10-Q Note 13 and MD&A (three-month). The 2016 growth tables are presented additively (Existing businesses + Acquisitions + Currency = Total); converted here to the schema's deduction convention (total + acq + fx = core), i.e. growth_acq / growth_fx / total_growth.acq / fx are the published acquisition and currency contributions with the sign flipped. Communications business (split off Jul-2015, formerly in Test & Measurement) excluded from all periods as discontinued operations. Fortive (T&M, most of Industrial Technologies, retail/commercial petroleum from Environmental) still in continuing operations this quarter.

FY2016 (raised): GAAP diluted EPS $4.27-$4.40; adjusted diluted EPS $4.85-$4.98 (gain on marketable securities ($0.20); separation costs $52m pretax / $53m after-tax, $0.08; amortization $642m pretax / $488m after-tax, $0.70). Guidance includes Fortive (spin expected Q3-16). No core growth guidance in release.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted diluted EPS from continuing operations (pre-spin definition): GAAP diluted EPS from continuing ops excluding amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, separation-preparation costs, gains on marketable securities and acquisition inventory fair-value charges, each shown after tax per share (no aggregate tax-effect line). Separation item after-tax ($14m) exceeds pretax ($9m) because it includes ~$6m discrete separation-related income tax; location set to 'op' (professional fees in SG&A). Release has no free cash flow table (text: FCF up over 50% y/y). Figures include Fortive (continuing operations until the 2-Jul-2016 spin).
